name: Non-syndromic Respiratory or Mediastinal Malformation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Non-syndromic Respiratory or Mediastinal Malformation Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of congenital malformation affecting respiratory tract or mediastinal structures without associated syndromic features
No clinical or genetic evidence of syndromic conditions involving respiratory or mediastinal malformations
Radiological confirmation of isolated respiratory or mediastinal malformation by CT, MRI, or prenatal ultrasound
Exclusion of infectious or inflammatory causes mimicking malformations

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: congenital respiratory or mediastinal malformation, absence of syndromic features, and imaging confirmation
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may be performed to exclude syndromic causes but is not diagnostic for this condition.

searchTerms: breathing difficulty due to airway shape
bluish skin during feeding or activity
turning blue with exertion or eating

occasional.notes: Due to underlying mediastinal mass effect

searchTerms: whistling breath sounds not from infection
high blood pressure in lungs from defect
pulmonary pressure increase due to malformation
shift of chest structures on imaging

laboratory: Normal inflammatory markers unless secondary infection present
imaging: Chest X-ray showing mediastinal mass or cystic lesion
CT scan demonstrating bronchial atresia or mediastinal malformation
MRI for detailed soft tissue characterization
genetic: No known causative gene identified for isolated non-syndromic cases
Genetic testing used to exclude syndromic conditions
other: Prenatal ultrasound may detect mediastinal cystic lesions

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of cystic lung lesions with systemic arterial supply
Often associated with recurrent infections and respiratory distress
Presence of additional syndromic features such as cardiac anomalies or craniofacial abnormalities

redFlags: Severe neonatal respiratory distress requiring ventilation
Rapidly enlarging mediastinal mass causing airway compression
references: Orphanet: Non-syndromic respiratory or mediastinal malformation, ORPHA:108993
